channel_instructions: Open the official Swisscom bereavement page (https://www.swisscom.ch/de/privatkunden/hilfe/daten-und-rechnungen/todesfall.html) and choose whether to cancel or take over the deceased person's subscription.
Alternatively, call the Swisscom hotline at 0800 800 800 to report the death and request cancellation or takeover of the subscription.
Have the Todesurkunde (Death Certificate) and the Erbenschein ready, and provide customer number, phone number(s) and address of the deceased person if available.
Submit the documents as instructed by Swisscom (via the bereavement page or the hotline) and request written confirmation of the cancellation.
Check that the final invoice (Schlussrechnung) is sent to the address of the deceased or the executor, and settle it with the estate.
If you have access to the deceased person's Swisscom login, you can also follow the Swisscom Community guide (Scenario 3) to cancel while keeping the address.
required_docs: Proof of identity of the person reporting (executor/heir)
Customer number or phone number of the deceased person (if available)

channel_instructions: Open https://support.spotify.com/ch-de/article/cancel-premium/ and follow the cancellation steps for Premium.
Log in to your Spotify account on the web (not only in the app) and go to the account page / subscription overview.

Confirm the cancellation by following the on-screen prompts. Premium Duo features stay available until the end of the current billing period.

If you subscribed through a partner provider or an app store (e.g. Apple, Google), cancel there instead, as Spotify cannot cancel those billing arrangements directly.
Keep the cancellation confirmation (email or screenshot) as proof.

channel_instructions: Open the LinkedIn Help page for deceased members: https://www.linkedin.com/help/linkedin/answer/a1380121/verstorbenes-linkedin-mitglied-profil-entfernen?lang=de and choose the option to close the account or memorialize the profile of a deceased member (report the member as deceased if you are not authorized to act on their behalf).
Prepare the required documents: Todesurkunde (Death Certificate) and Erbenschein, plus proof of your identity and your relationship to the deceased.
Submit the request with the member's profile URL, the member's name and the date of death, and upload the documents through the form.

To cancel the LinkedIn Premium Business subscription, follow the instructions at https://www.linkedin.com/help/linkedin/answer/a545579/linkedin-premium-mitgliedschaft-kundigen?lang=de and select the option matching how the subscription was purchased (LinkedIn website, Apple App Store, Google Play, or invoice/sales contact).

If the portal does not allow completion, contact LinkedIn Customer Support via https://www.linkedin.com/help/linkedin/answer/a518597?lang=de (chat or ticket; no hotline or support email exists) and reference the notification of death under Swiss Law (OR Art. 405).
Request written confirmation of the cancellation, the stop of future charges, and any pro-rata refund for the period after death. Keep it with the estate records.
